body: I'm storing int values (and also experience this issue), it seems that the extension executes "DEL" when initializing the session in some moment and the values are removed.
We're using https://github.com/phpnode/YiiRedis with 1.1 in production. Works flawlessly so can probably be used as a reference.
Note that this issue is only about the ActiveRecord. If there is something wrong with session, please open a new issue for that. Updated the title.
I'd like to try fixing this before RC because it may require changes in data model of redis AR.

Redis can't store nulls but we can remove the key in this case:
- When saving remove keys with null values using `HDEL`.
- When filtering by field with value of `null` use `HEXISTS`.
sounds like a solution, what about booleans?
Booleans seems to be automatically coverted to ints by Redis when saved so in conditions these should be converted to ints as well.

One tricky thing is `asArray`. In the resulting data there's no more fields which should be with null values. Because of it we have to create instance of the model, get attributes and check if all these are present in resulting data. If not, these should be added with null values.

issue.title: Fixed storing and loading nulls and booleans in Redis
